study: Paper baseline extension: MLP-Cox versus frozen Cox and RSF
seed_derivation: label + 1000*outer_fold + (inner_fold+1 for inner fitting; 0 for outer refit)

mlp.loss: event-mean negative full-risk-set Cox partial likelihood

selection.tie_break: smaller hidden architecture, then larger weight_decay
selection.early_stop: inner validation Cox loss; restore best checkpoint
selection.outer_epochs: median of the five best epochs of the selected candidate
selection.seed_sensitivity: each seed repeats the complete inner selection and outer refit; no seed ensemble or best-seed selection

evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the five outer-fold metrics; report min/max, not confidence intervals
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: paired patient IDs across all algorithms/modalities; Hebei resampled within each fixed test fold
evaluation.uncertainty_scope: conditional on trained models and frozen folds; excludes retraining, tuning, split variation and historical selection uncertainty
evaluation.historical_bias: Fujian outcomes were previously examined; the frozen 100-patient subset was selected after performance inspection and overlaps the 232-patient cohort. All external conclusions remain exploratory.

execution.old_baselines: read-only reload and metric recomputation; no retraining or overwriting
